steps.title: Start the documented cleanroom run
steps.instructions: Reconstructed workflow from the published prompt and available result artifacts; this is not a recorded sequence of agent turns. Give an isolated Codex agent the unchanged prompt, pinned Burr and routed CAD skills, and an empty workspace, as recorded in the run report.

steps.title: Build the mechanism and motion
steps.instructions: Generate the five printable parts, purchased-hardware envelopes, fold poses and engaged/released lock details, then configure the named Fold hanger motion.

steps.title: Keep both validation results
steps.instructions: Check all final CAD targets and pairwise STEP intersections in five poses. Preserve Burr’s failed/incomplete interference results alongside the exact geometry evidence.

steps.title: Review the known repair
steps.instructions: Read the publication review: the assembly guide’s spring guide pegs are missing from the source. Keep the result repair-required and run the physical test plan before any use; geometry does not establish a load rating.
